meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频中的人声与配乐做混音:淡入淡出、交叉过渡、音量自动化、人声压过配乐、效果链与分组总控。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里已有旁白和背景音乐,却总在互相打架。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover and music track keep fighting each other in the same video.

howto.what: 让 Claude 为已放置进 HyperFrames 合成的音频做混音:设置淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道音量与音量自动化,添加 EQ、压缩器等效果链,并处理播报人声削减(voiceover carve)与分组总线。
howto.when: 当合成里已有音频、需要做混音(淡入淡出、交叉淡化、音量自动化等)时触发。找 BGM、生成配音走 /media-use;剪辑时间与轨道布局走 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给 music 轨加 1 秒淡入、2 秒淡出,音量降到 -6 dB
say.note: 会写入轨道增益与淡入淡出包络

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, ducking, voiceover carve, effect chains (EQ, compressor, reverb) and submix buses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing — fades, crossfades, volume or effect automation. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Fade the music track in over 1s and out over 2s, and drop its gain to -6 dB
say_en.note: Writes track gain and fade envelopes

say_en.text: Carve the music bed against the voiceover, strength 0.8
say_en.note: Writes the chain and automation onto the bed element

say_en.text: Group the narration under data-audio-group=voiceover, then carve the bed
say_en.note: Clips added to the group are covered
